_why: Skill-candidates row 1406 'gate-on-two-independent-clocks': the heartbeat alone misread a working lane as dead four times. liveness_evidence reads four clocks; LIVE on any fresh one, QUIET only when all are readable and cold, UNKNOWN otherwise. Each row reverts one arm of that disjunction or one consumer and names the test that bites.

mutations.name: ps-match-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A process running under the owner's session id proves nothing, so case 3 (idle between turns, transcript frozen) reads QUIET.

mutations.name: transcript-clock-ignored
mutations._mechanism: Only the other clocks can prove life: cases 2 and 4 (transcript seconds old, heartbeat cold) read QUIET.
mutations.find: if seconds is not None and seconds <= window
mutations.replace: if clock != "transcript" and seconds is not None and seconds <= window

mutations.name: commit-clock-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A lane shipping commits with a cold heartbeat (case 1) reads QUIET.
mutations.find: if seconds is not None and seconds <= window
mutations.replace: if clock != "commit" and seconds is not None and seconds <= window

mutations.name: heartbeat-clock-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A freshly beaten claim is not LIVE on its own heartbeat.
mutations.find: if seconds is not None and seconds <= window
mutations.replace: if clock != "heartbeat" and seconds is not None and seconds <= window

mutations.name: window-boundary-exclusive
mutations._mechanism: Age exactly at the window reads stale, disagreeing with owner_is_live's inclusive boundary.
mutations.find: if seconds is not None and seconds <= window
mutations.replace: if seconds is not None and seconds < window

mutations.name: unreadable-clock-reads-quiet
mutations._mechanism: A partial read falls through to QUIET: 'could not check' reads as 'dead'.

mutations.name: all-cold-reads-unknown
mutations._mechanism: Every clock readable and cold still reports UNKNOWN, so a dead lane can never be called QUIET.

mutations.name: failed-ps-not-unreadable
mutations._mechanism: ps failing is ignored, so a reading that could not have seen the live process says QUIET.
mutations.find:
if owner and commands is None:
        unreadable.append("ps")

mutations.name: ps-prefix-match
mutations._mechanism: A longer id that merely starts with the owner's matches, so another session's process proves this one alive.

mutations.name: live-runs-heartbeat-only
mutations._mechanism: The consumer goes back to the heartbeat alone: a lane working with a cold heartbeat reads 'no run here'.

mutations.name: live-runs-unjudged-reads-none
mutations._mechanism: A cold claim with an unreadable clock is dropped, and 'could not judge' prints NONE.

mutations.name: refusal-omits-evidence
mutations._mechanism: The --claim refusal that names force shows only the heartbeat, so forcing is decided on one clock.
mutations.find: raise StateWriteError(f"{exc} {liveness_evidence(prior, lane, now)}") from None

mutations.name: bare-mention-is-a-process
mutations._mechanism: SF1: any argv naming the id counts, so the checker's own shell, a grep or a tail of the transcript reads a dead owner LIVE.

mutations.name: merges-refresh-the-commit-clock
mutations._mechanism: SF2: merging main into the lane branch reads as the owner working.

mutations.name: nested-lane-reads-repo-head
mutations._mechanism: SF2: a lane nested in a busy repo inherits every commit anywhere in it.

mutations.name: claim-scopes-commits-to-docs
mutations._mechanism: SF2: the --claim reading is scoped to docs/, so only state-file commits count.
mutations.find: lane = state_path.parent.parent if state_path.parent.name == "docs" else state_path.parent

mutations.name: minted-owner-needs-a-transcript
mutations._mechanism: SF3: a Codex/agy owner can never have a transcript, so its crashed claim is UNKNOWN forever.
mutations.find: elif ages["transcript"] is None and not minted:

mutations.name: any-minted-file-is-this-owner
mutations._mechanism: SF3: any minted id in the git dir drops the transcript clock, even another session's.

mutations.name: subagent-transcripts-ignored
mutations._mechanism: SF4: an owner waiting on a long subagent writes only the subagent transcript, and reads QUIET while working.

mutations.name: clocks-off-switch-ignored
mutations._mechanism: SF5: the switch is read but ignored, so tests read the host's real ps, git and ~/.claude.

mutations.name: conftest-leaves-clocks-on
mutations._mechanism: SF5: the suite no longer sets the switch, so every claim refusal reads the host.

mutations.name: stale-takeover-is-silent
mutations._mechanism: SF6: a plain --claim of a stale-looking claim (incident 2) prints nothing.

mutations.name: clocks-read-under-the-store-lock
mutations._mechanism: Nit 3: a hung ps holds the store lock against the owner's own --beat.
mutations.find:
if held_by and held_by != session_id:
            prior.update(record)

mutations.name: no-claim-reads-unknown
mutations._mechanism: Nit 2: a lane with nothing claimed reads UNKNOWN, so UNKNOWN stops meaning 'could not read'.

mutations.name: unjudged-gets-no-hold-advice
mutations._mechanism: Nit 4: a claim that could not be judged may be a live run, but gets no advice to hold.
mutations.find:
if live or unjudged:
        print("  a skill change lands
mutations.replace:
if live:
        print("  a skill change lands
